paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
notes: Astrophysical (stellar) bound from non-observation of X-rays from magnetic white dwarf RE J0317-853 with Chandra. Fundamental measured limit is g_aee*g_agamma < 1.3e-25 GeV^-1 for m_a << 5e-6 eV (95% CL). Translated to g_agamma <= 5.5e-13 sqrt(Caggamma/Caee) GeV^-1 for m_a <= 5e-6 eV; here I emit the Caee=Caggamma case (5.5e-13). For the conservative W-phobic loop-induced case Caee~1.5e-4 Caggamma the bound is g_agamma ~ 4.4e-11 GeV^-1. Not a DM search, so no local density. Limit is flat below ~5e-6 eV then weakens; horizontal line encodes the flat portion. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.82, 2))
